notes.title: Picture Books & Continues! Update information on 12/22
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33722220/f82749dc55dbb26a7a5f12cc8463ea19c994e344.png[/img]
The Black Bird flies again! We just updated the game to add the new storybooks which the PS4/5 versions launched with recently and added continue functionality too!
[list]
[*] Added two secret picture books as rewards for finishing the game
[*] Added CONTINUE functionality at game over
[/list]
Enjoy
